Description:
High res portraits of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] mod female NPCs (Alissa, Corine, Flor, Maddie, Ysabelle), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait.
Including beach portraits.

[b][u][size=5]Beauty is in the eyes of the beholder, don't like don't download.[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10775][size=4]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10775[/size][/url]


Drag the folder [b]( [CP] Ridgeside Village )[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b][b]Ridgeside Village Mod[/b] folder to overwrite the original [b]( [CP] Ridgeside Village)[/b] folder for it to work, it replaces those 5 character's default portraits. 

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ mod.)
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000
[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

08/22/2021: Uploaded CP version 
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

08/25/2021: Uploaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] version.
For people who prefer to install them in Portraiture or having people disappearing issues in 64bit version game.
